correctness.rationale: Complete enumeration of 342 faces (including empty), 168 acyclic matching pairs checked on all 1020 Hasse cover relations, and explicit recursive signed integral Morse boundary (zero 2x2 differential). One 0-cell, two 2-cells, two 3-cells, and no others form a simply connected CW model; Hurewicz identifies nullhomotopic three-cell attaching maps, proving the wedge. Independent mod 2/3/5 ranks corroborate.

Targeted comparisons against other matching-complex classes and available indexed results found no dominating statement for the pentagonal prism; unindexed work remains a residual risk.
residual_risks: An unindexed or independently published matching-complex computation may already include the same ten-vertex graph.
The complete text of arXiv:2609.27366 was not available for inspection; its stated focus is a different rectangular graph.
The 2024 outerplanar and 2022 polygonal-line primary papers were inspected for theorem hypotheses and relevant definitions, not exhaustively for every later example.

value.rationale: Determines an exact integral homotopy type for a natural nontriangular odd-width circular ladder that was specifically posed as an open direction (ordinary matching complexes, Agarwal–Basak Problem 26). The mixed-dimensional sphere wedge strongly contrasts with the known contractible perfect matching subcomplex; a complete graph-specific homotopy result is meaningful without a universal-width formula.
